youtube.description:
Undo the AI: Kiro checkpoints and rewind in 4 steps

Four steps to undo what the AI just did in Kiro.

1. Let it work - Kiro tracks what the agent changes.
2. Spot a bad turn - Find the point where it went wrong.
3. Rewind - Go back to an earlier checkpoint.
4. Know the catch - Your manual edits are not tracked.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/checkpoints/
